dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The People of the Springs welcome you, guests from afar! You are currently at the east entrance to our tribal lands."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "This noticeboard will display important tribal announcements, must-know information for tourists, and various ads from major stores. We hope you will find what you need here, and do enjoy your stay!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Look at the majestic ship-shaped structure up ahead. That, friends, is our grand theater!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Whenever important festivals come up, this is where we host grand performances. You don't want to miss 'em!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Additionally, guests can also enjoy musical performances at Colomche Plaza, in front of the theater, at any time!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "If you follow the path on the left, you'll be greeted by Djembe Studios and Xochicuicatl Records, and if you follow that path down and past the hot springs, you'll be on your way to the restaurant, 'Golden Dusk.'"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The path on the right will take you to the Leisurely Puffer, where you can get lovely and practical watersports gear of all sorts!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "We hope you enjoy your time here with us!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "It is our honor to announce to all People of the Springs that another Pilgrimage is soon to come!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The contestants representing us are as lively as ever!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Liliuo, the Frost Star of Ixquimilli, who once fought alongside Atea the Candlekeeper, will take the field once more!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "The veteran Kaiulani, who has taken part in the tournament for thirteen straight years, is making a play for the Night Warden Wars once again!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Many more familiar faces on the docket! Izapa, the famous Colomche Plaza musician, and his companions are also taking part!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "And of course, everyone's familiar, favorite, friendly owner of the Leisurely Puffer... 'Umo{RUBY#[D]Unity}ja' Mualani!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "Let us send our brave warriors the greatest blessings and warmest well-wishes we have~"

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Please take note of the following before entering the hot springs."

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "First, pick the right pool, and watch the water temperature, or you might get scalded. Travelers from abroad should get acclimated to an artificial pool first before trying any natural ones!"

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Next up, no playing around in the hot springs. Not only will this disturb others, but you might also slip and fall."

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Last of all, know your limits. Don't be afraid to step out should you feel uncomfortable, and don't forget to drink water and eat some food to keep your stamina up."

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Please take note of the following before entering the hot springs."

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "First, pick the right pool, and watch the water temperature, or you might get scalded. Travelers from abroad should get acclimated to an artificial pool first before trying any natural ones!"

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Next up, no playing around in the hot springs. Not only will this disturb others, but you might also slip and fall."

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Last of all, know your limits. Don't be afraid to step out should you feel uncomfortable, and don't forget to drink water and eat some food to keep your stamina up."

dialogues.speaker: Energetic Handwriting
dialogues.text: "And remember kids, don't pour milk into the hot springs, and don't throw stones in either! Big Sis Mualani's gonna be mad otherwise!"

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "Dear guests, remember not to provoke the Koholasaurs, whether young or mature, if you do not have any experience in communicating with them!"

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "Don't be fooled by their calm nature and their preference for being sedentary in the springs. They can be quite the slow starters when it comes to new friends."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "Feeding them stimulating foods or trying to get close too early might scare them away, and they might either avoid you in future or politely refuse contact."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "And I'm sure you don't want to be thrown into the sea by one of them after they bop you with their heads, or have one of them grab you and pull you over to Chief Amina's, right? So yes. Take your time, and don't rush it~"

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "Surfing open from 08:00 – 01:00."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "Just find yourself a good swell, pick up a suitable surfboard, and you too can experience the joys of surfing whenever you want..."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "Well, but with the knowledge that lifeguards need to rest as well — for safety reasons, you understand! Thanks for your cooperation."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "Beach Volleyball open from 10:00 – 22:00."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "As long as you're passionate and find yourself the right ball, you can all enjoy a game of volleyball at any time..."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "But volleyball's not a quiet game, so to ensure that other tourists can get a good night's rest, only play during the designated hours! Thanks for your cooperation."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "Parasailing open from 11:00 – 23:00."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "All you need is courage and sufficient strength to enjoy the sea breeze against your skin at any time..."

dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: "But parasailing can be even more dangerous than surfing, so don't try it while tired! Thanks for your cooperation."

dialogues.speaker: Djembe Studios Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Here, we sell all kinds of instruments, from beginner kits to artisan works custom-crafted for your performances. Feel free to come and try them out!"

dialogues.speaker: Djembe Studios Advertisement
dialogues.text: "At the same, we hope that all music-loving customers have a basic estimation of the difficulty of learning their desired instrument and the time and effort required before making a purchase."

dialogues.speaker: Djembe Studios Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Practicing your instrument can be a long, lonely journey, but playing your instrument is one of the greatest experiences in the world."

dialogues.speaker: Djembe Studios Advertisement
dialogues.text: "May you find your true instrument love, may you give your musical learning journey all the time it needs, and may you shock the world someday!"

dialogues.speaker: Xochicuicatl Records Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Xochicuicatl Records, the foremost musical vault in the People of the Springs. All sorts of records here for sale!"

dialogues.speaker: Xochicuicatl Records Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Full of creative inspiration, but don't know how to put your work to pen, much less to product? Leave it to us. We provide assistance from steps A to Z!"

dialogues.speaker: Xochicuicatl Records Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Composing, recording, producing... There are dozens of steps, and we do 'em all! Leave these affairs to your friendly representatives here at Xochicuicatl Records — your best music-making partners!"

dialogues.speaker: Atlahua's Net Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Fishing supplies, ornaments, and all manner of tools — come catch 'em all at Atlahua's Net! Fishing rod-fixing services provided too!"

dialogues.speaker: Atlahua's Net Advertisement
dialogues.text: "We also make custom-made souvenirs, and stuff for your Saurian buddy, too! Our shopkeeper's specialty is improvisation, after all — so come in and have a look. You won't regret it!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Sky-blue seas, milk-white hot springs, ash-grey mountain rock... The colors of nature reflect the vistas of the world. They teach us down-to-earth artistry."

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "But life is not unchanging! Sometimes, what you need is excitement beyond the pale! And you — yes you, filled as you are with creativity... Do you not yearn to unleash the colorful ideas that spring to life in your head?"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Join us! Join the Graffiti Alliance. Grab your spray cans, and create untold masterpieces alongside us!"

dialogues.speaker: Graffiti Alliance Announcement
dialogues.text: "Our goal is to take every last cliff in Natlan, every last giant rock, every last flat wall, and fill them with the trendiest, most avant-garde graffiti. We'll hit 'em with more new art than they can swing a talking stick at!"

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Children of Meztli, hear my voice."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The Night Warden Wars have left us weary, but Unity and the hot springs will see us through."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Occasions such as this are beautiful indeed, yet the tainted currents have infringed upon it."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The golden-haired hero revealed the truth and swept the Abyss from the land..."

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "People of the Springs! To commemorate our victory, I have decided to set aside a day of annual remembrance where we might come together and celebrate!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "It shall be a day when we thank the heroes who saved Natlan and ensure that their names live on for all time!"

dialogues.speaker: Tribal Announcement
dialogues.text: "I will invite Sadigua to tell stories of the heroes' mighty deeds, and so shall they be remembered!"
